SelectionRationale: Calendar/mechanical diversity, not prior model agreement: 2021 snow/foretell (KHM), spells/lesson (STX), dice/dungeons (AFR), graveyard/vampires (VOW); 2022 enchantment/artifact (NEO), three-color (SNC), domain (DMU), artifacts (BRO); 2023 adventure (WOE), artifact/typal/discovery (LCI); 2024 investigate (MKM), multicolor/outlaws (OTJ), typal (BLB), enchantments/survival (DSK). Fast/slow and synergy/power differences will be diagnostic, not outcome-based selection criteria.
HoldoutPolicy: Qualification may inspect schema/identity/missingness metadata. Do not compute holdout performance, quality distributions or candidate metrics before selection. Select using calibration/development, freeze selection, then release exactly one final holdout evaluation; no retuning afterward.
WithinSetObservationSplit: SHA256(provider/set/format/draft_id), seed=DraftTG-phase-b-v1: disjoint evidence and target draft groups, independent of outcomes; all games from one draft stay together.
PrimaryObjective: Held-out game-presence GIH prediction MAE with Brier/calibration diagnostics and set macro-average; sparse evidence and target games are disjoint. Copy-weighted counts are separately audited, not silently interchangeable.
CrossFormatMissingDataPolicy: Measure only legitimately available same-set pairs; unavailable multiple-Quick evidence is a reported limitation, never synthesized from Premier or Traditional.
ResourcePolicy: Prefer bounded stratified seekable row-group samples; cap retained data to a few GiB and avoid full multi-gigabyte CSV downloads. Report effective coverage and selection bias. Full production replay can use a preregistered deterministic subset if full replay is impractical.
